reasons.c_dow: day-of-week / weekend indicator: five weeks cannot identify a weekday effect (plan, 2026-10-06)
reasons.cd_creator_shares_funder: Severity MAJEUR. Bias: hindsight flag with whole-corpus measurement coverage. The hub status of a LAST funder is not measured at the row's funding time. last_funding() calls hub_of(sender), a plain lookup by address in the genesis_hop cache, with no time argument. That cache holds an address only if it was the funder in the genesis record of some collected wallet (core, creator, early, and 'late' wallets first seen between the alert and alert + 29 s, for every collected alert), and the status is taken before the earliest such genesis funding over the whole corpus. Two consequences: (a) 'measur

reasons.tr_ex_any: Same hindsight hub flag, diluted: any = w, c, k keys plus the non-strict f key. Outcome gates in code: YA and A_mfe_900s at t_j + 960 s, YE1 at t_j + 3,660 s, none for tr_since_any (keys only, t_j < t_i - 1 s). Those gates hold on the data.
reasons.tr_ex_f: Hindsight hub flag in the identity key (small in size, leak by rule). The f key drops a last funder when cd last_funder_hub is True. That flag is the genesis_hop record of the address, which exists only because the address genesis-funded some wallet of the corpus, possibly in a later alert, and it is measured at that funding (the cursor), not at the alert. The outcome gate itself is correct (YA, t_j + 960 s).
